cases.name: no-seed
cases.description: an <env> with no seed= draws a different file on every run

cases.name: an-empty-seed-is-a-seed
cases.description: seed="" is a seed like any other — the empty text — and fixes the file

cases.name: minutes-for-month
cases.description: "mm" is minutes; with no hour beside it, every date prints month 00
cases.config: <tdc><env count="3" seed="s"><sequence name="A"><gen type="date" from="2025-01-01" to="2025-12-31" format="YYYY-mm-DD"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{A}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: one-m-for-month
cases.description: "m" is minutes too, and is read the same way
cases.config: <tdc><env count="3" seed="s"><sequence name="A"><gen type="date" from="2025-01-01" to="2025-12-31" format="D.m.YYYY"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{A}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: minutes-beside-an-hour
cases.description: with HH in the format the minutes are meant
cases.config: <tdc><env count="3" seed="s"><sequence name="A"><gen type="date" from="2025-01-01" to="2025-12-31" format="YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{A}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: minutes-beside-seconds
cases.description: mm:ss is a clock reading without an hour, and meant
cases.config: <tdc><env count="3" seed="s"><sequence name="A"><gen type="date" from="2025-01-01" to="2025-12-31" format="mm:ss"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{A}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: minutes-in-a-literal
cases.description: [mm] is literal text, not a token
cases.config: <tdc><env count="3" seed="s"><sequence name="A"><gen type="date" from="2025-01-01" to="2025-12-31" format="YYYY-MM-DD [mm]"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{A}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: minutes-beside-a-named-clock
cases.description: LLL carries a time of day of its own
cases.config: <tdc><env count="3" seed="s"><sequence name="A"><gen type="date" from="2025-01-01" to="2025-12-31" format="LLL mm"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{A}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: minutes-beside-a-named-date
cases.description: ISO is a date with no time, so the minutes beside it are still a month
cases.config: <tdc><env count="3" seed="s"><sequence name="A"><gen type="date" from="2025-01-01" to="2025-12-31" format="ISO mm"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{A}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: minutes-on-a-birth-date
cases.description: a birth-date template prints through format= the same way

cases.name: minutes-on-a-date-offset
cases.description: a date measured from another prints through format= the same way
cases.config: <tdc><env count="3" seed="s"><sequence name="A"><gen type="date" from="2025-01-01" to="2025-12-31"/></sequence><sequence name="B"><gen type="date" of="A" plus="1d" format="YYYY-mm-DD"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{B}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: a-date-offset-format-is-checked
cases.description: format= on an offset went unchecked: YYY printed 25Y on every row
cases.config: <tdc><env count="3" seed="s"><sequence name="A"><gen type="date" from="2025-01-01" to="2025-12-31"/></sequence><sequence name="B"><gen type="date" of="A" plus="1d" format="YYY"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{B}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: an-entity-in-a-line
cases.description: " reaches the output as six characters, and the JSON breaks

cases.name: a-numeric-entity
cases.description: a numeric reference is printed as written too

cases.name: an-entity-in-a-composed-sequence
cases.description: a literal piece of a composed value prints the same way

cases.name: an-entity-in-a-fixture
cases.description: a fixture line prints the same way as a block line

cases.name: a-bare-ampersand
cases.description: an & that starts no entity is just a character
cases.config: <tdc><env count="3" seed="s"><sequence name="A"><gen type="text" value="x"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>Tom & Jerry; A&B; &amp ${{A}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: report-order
cases.description: all three in one file: the seed first, the format where it stands, the entity last
